args.goal: Test whether an existing GlobalLand deliverable can satisfy one explicit scored criterion on a still-open opportunity already listed in the verified open-software-tenders release. Select at most one listing other than North Ayrshire to keep this distinct from the active notice-delta and prime-subcontract work. Read prior bidder worksheets and relevant lessons first. Reuse an equivalent committed sample if present. Verify the current deadline and exact buyer criterion against official public records. Check whether the required tender pack, bidder eligibility, response channel and contract scope support a standalone response or require a wider prime bid. If a credible response path and public acceptance criterion exist, adapt one existing deliverable into a submission-ready excerpt and run a reproducible check with fictional data where applicable. Cite the criterion verbatim, identify what the excerpt demonstrates, and record the remaining authorization, acceptance and settlement evidence needed. If the criterion or response path cannot be verified, save the specific bid/no-bid finding and the fact that would reopen it. Read the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No bidding, external contact, registrations, spending or deployment. Any eventual public revision requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
